scope: Short fifty-user numeric-form candidate without stack profiling; not full acceptance
limitations: The offered duration is shorter than acceptance; slow actions extended the actual windows and reduced achieved cadence.

The host observation is a warmup snapshot, not a measurement-window average or CPU attribution.
The separate process sampler retained top-process deltas but its total-CPU aggregation failed; no complete host attribution is available.
